title: TEE-X: TEE-aware Acceleration Framework for Large Vision Models at the Edge
abstract: arXiv:2608.22716v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite their remarkable success, machine learning models, particularly in vision applications, are alarmingly vulnerable to a range of security threats. One key factor in the attack landscape is the distinction between white-box and black-box threat models, as the latter poses challenges that limit attack effectiveness when access to model information is limited. As a result, using Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) enhances security for machine learning applications by protecting model confidentiality and execution integrity, effectively shifting the execution environment from the white-box to the black-box side of the threat model spectrum. While adopting TEEs for large vision models, e.g., Vision Transformers (ViTs), is crucial for enhancing security and privacy, significant challenges related to memory constraints and increased computational latency must be addressed, especially in time-sensitive edge applications where safety

translated_title: TEE-X：面向边缘大型视觉模型的TEE感知加速框架
translated_abstract: 尽管机器学习模型取得了显著成功，尤其是在视觉应用中，但它们却极易受到一系列安全威胁。攻击场景中的一个关键因素是白盒与黑盒威胁模型之间的区别，因为后者在模型信息访问受限时，会限制攻击的有效性，从而带来挑战。因此，使用可信执行环境（TEEs）通过保护模型机密性和执行完整性来增强机器学习应用的安全性，有效地将执行环境从威胁模型谱系的白盒侧转向黑盒侧。虽然为大型视觉模型（例如视觉变换器ViTs）采用TEEs对于增强安全性和隐私性至关重要，但必须解决与内存限制和计算延迟增加相关的重大挑战，尤其是在对时间敏感的边缘应用中，安全性至关重要。
tldr: 本文提出了TEE-X框架，旨在通过TEE感知的加速方法，解决边缘部署大型视觉模型时的内存和延迟问题，同时提升安全性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TEE-X, a TEE-aware acceleration framework designed to address memory and latency challenges in deploying large vision models at the edge while enhancing security.
